Package neqsim.process.equipment.distillation

Class SarirAtmosphericSideStripperContactScreen

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.distillation.SarirAtmosphericSideStripperContactScreen
public final class SarirAtmosphericSideStripperContactScreen extends Object
Source-bounded equilibrium-contact screen for a Sarir atmospheric side-stripper service.

The public Sarir reference reports steam rate, temperature, and pressure for the kerosene and diesel side strippers, but it does not report side-stripper topology, tray count, pressure, injection location, efficiency, steam quality, or enthalpy. This class therefore contacts one already calculated atmospheric-column liquid side draw with one independently prepared steam stream on a single equilibrium SimpleTray. The caller must supply the contact pressure and auditable steam-state provenance.

The result is a screening calculation only. It is not a multistage side-stripper model and must not be treated as a reproduction of plant product quality or yield.

  • Method Details

    • configure

      public static SarirAtmosphericSideStripperContactScreen configure(SarirAtmosphericFractionationCase fractionationCase, SarirAtmosphericReference.SteamInjectionService service, StreamInterface preparedSteam, SarirAtmosphericMainSteamScreen.ReportedPressureBasis reportedPressureBasis, String thermodynamicStateBasis, double contactPressureBara)
      Configure one equilibrium contact using a solved qualified Sarir side draw.
      Parameters:
      fractionationCase - already solved qualified Sarir atmospheric case
      service - kerosene or diesel side-stripper service
      preparedSteam - independently prepared, essentially pure-water gas stream matching the selected published steam row
      reportedPressureBasis - explicit absolute or gauge interpretation of source pressure
      thermodynamicStateBasis - non-blank description of independent steam-state evidence
      contactPressureBara - explicit single-contact pressure in bar absolute
      Returns:
      configured source-bounded equilibrium-contact screen
